body:
1. BUG-2135: PR #2656 at dc1f3ff110 (draft, label: factory)
- Solved deleted TMPDIR failure across aida-host, dev_build, and check-ci-gates.
- Scripted repro and detection tests in tests/test_bug_2135_sccache_tmpdir.py and dev_build_tests.rs.
- All 28 gates in make check-ci-fast passed.

2. BUG-2010 (second attempt): PR #2657 at 434cc3076f (draft, label: factory)
- Recycled lane names: required active_pid == agent.pid with process_identity_is_alive start-time identity, or lease started_at >= agent.started_at - 5s.
- Registry update: session_start updates session_agent's own entry under update_agent_current_spec(&project_root, &agent.id, owns, &worktree_path).
- Test wiring: bug_2010_factory_lane_ps_tests.rs calls session_start to mint lease, verifies AC1 (owner, creator_pid, active_pid), and directly invokes session_leases and classify_session_leases.
- Anti-spoofing: verified live non-ancestor child PID is rejected by resolve_session_agent_for_lease.
- Drain phase children: orchestrator::detect(&project_root).is_orchestrated() skips agent attribution and preserves user.email fallback.
- Liveness API: aida-core/src/liveness.rs completely untouched.
- All 28 gates in make check-ci-fast passed.
subject: [FACTORY] PR #2656 (BUG-2135) and PR #2657 (BUG-2010) ready for review
